My honest, non-sponsored review of the Vitruvian Trainer+ – Ian's blog
s: There is a lot to love about the Vitruvian Trainer+ but ultimately it’s too much money for a too-buggy product. For me, I want connected fitness equipment – an all-in-one system. This is not that. It’s not even close, even if they fixed all the software bugs. I didn’t want to bet $3,600 on software fixes and feature improvements coming eventually at $40 a month, so back it goes. If you’re considering buying a Vitruvian Trainer+ I hope this helped.
